notes.title: Hardcore Trivia EA-version Released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40934929/75d24f4f5cba39c7b0761ccd6e4b0db96083e4a0.png

Hi!

We have now released Hardcore Trivia EA-version!

A long await is over! Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

Game currently include these challenging quizzes:


    Caribbean Flag Quiz (10 questions)

    All-Stars Ice-Hockey Quiz (10 questions)

    Solar System Trivia (10 questions)

    General Knowledge Quiz (10 questions)

    The Rome Empire (10 questions)


Each theme include presentation video on starting and in the end and music, which we have specially pick to match the each theme atmosphere. Game is not a boring one ːsteamboredː

More to come!

The base game grows to at least 100 question-wide, including at least 10 different themes and interesting DLC-quizzes are added during the development process! What themes would you like to have? Tell us your opinion!

Challenge your brains and have a fun time! Hardcore trivia offers questions for many needs. It's time to test your knowledge! 4 themes: All-Stars ice-hockey Quiz, Caribbean Flags Quiz, Solar System Trivia and General knowledge Quiz! More to come.

The base game grows to at least 100 question-wide, including at least 10 different themes and interesting DLC-quizzes are added during the development process!

Challenge your brains and have a fun time! Hardcore trivia offers questions for many needs. It's time to test your knowledge! 4 themes: All-Stars ice-hockey Quiz, Caribbean Flags Quiz, Solar System Trivia and General knowledge Quiz!

Current state of the game includes 50 questions (5 themes) and each theme question have 4 options. Can you find the right one?

We hope that you will have fun with our game, and we are pretty sure about that. 

Feel free to send any feedback! ːsummer2019flagː

Best regards
Icany

ːsteamthumbsupː

P.S.

In case you are running a school club, bar, restaurant or society, check out our future options for you (Commercial Licence). Commercial Licence has already been enabled, but it includes points calculation system which is not usually suitable if you are running the game to large audience in our Pen & Paper -format. Tailored version for larger audience is coming soon.
